proposal.reason: The substantive change is a broad overhaul of open-source CI validation: dual-platform (M890P and OAM-810E) case generation/grouping, workflow matrices and node/rack allocation behavior, optional HPN SDK installation plumbing, expanded native-unit case families, and reporting/reconciliation/log artifact handling. Added scripts and large omitted test-list JSONs are all part of CI test input generation/execution coverage rather than PCCL runtime modules or review-policy workflow logic.
